```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)
library(DT)
library(htmltools)

base_viti <- readRDS("base_viti_34_pac.rds") |>
  filter(
    EST_SIEGE_SOCIAL == "Oui",
    !is.na(LATITUDE),
    !is.na(LONGITUDE)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    LIEN_PAPPERS = paste0("[https://www.pappers.fr/entreprise/](https://www.pappers.fr/entreprise/)", SIREN),
    ADRESSE_COMPLETE = trimws(paste(
      ifelse(is.na(COMPLEMENT_ADRESSE), "", COMPLEMENT_ADRESSE),
      ifelse(is.na(ADRESSE_VOIE), "", ADRESSE_VOIE),
      ifelse(is.na(CODE_POSTAL), "", CODE_POSTAL),
      ifelse(is.na(COMMUNE), "", COMMUNE)
    )),
    MONTANT_PAC_ARRONDI = round(MONTANT_TOTAL_PAC_EUR),
    BADGE_PAC = ifelse(
      BENEFICIAIRE_PAC == "Oui",
      paste0("<span style='background:#E8F5E9; color:#2E7D32; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:12px; font-weight:600; font-size:12px;'>PAC : ",
             format(MONTANT_PAC_ARRONDI, big.mark = " "), " €</span>"),
      "<span style='background:#F1F5F9; color:#64748B; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:12px; font-weight:500; font-size:12px;'>Non bénéficiaire PAC</span>"
    ),
    POPUP_HTML = paste0(
      "<div style='min-width:240px; font-family:Inter,sans-serif; line-height:1.45;'>",
      "<div style='font-size:14px; font-weight:700; color:#5C1A2A; margin-bottom:2px;'>", htmlEscape(NOM_ETABLISSEMENT), "</div>",
      "<div style='font-size:12px; color:#64748B; margin-bottom:8px;'>", htmlEscape(ACTIVITE_PRINCIPALE), "</div>",
      "<div style='margin-bottom:8px;'>", BADGE_PAC, "</div>",
      "<div style='font-size:12px; color:#334155; margin-bottom:4px;'><b>Adresse :</b> ", htmlEscape(ADRESSE_COMPLETE), "</div>",
      "<div style='font-size:12px; color:#334155; margin-bottom:10px;'><b>SIREN :</b> ", SIREN, "</div>",
      "<div style='display:flex; gap:6px;'>",
      "<a href='", LIEN_GOOGLE_MAPS, "' target='_blank' ",
      "style='flex:1; text-align:center; background:#5C1A2A; color:white; padding:6px 10px; text-decoration:none; border-radius:6px; font-size:12px; font-weight:500;'>Itinéraire GPS</a>",
      "<a href='", LIEN_PAPPERS, "' target='_blank' ",
      "style='flex:1; text-align:center; background:#1E293B; color:white; padding:6px 10px; text-decoration:none; border-radius:6px; font-size:12px; font-weight:500;'>Fiche Pappers</a>",
      "</div></div>"
    )
  )

# 3 segments pour filtrer par potentiel directement sur la carte
base_pac_gros   <- base_viti |> filter(BENEFICIAIRE_PAC == "Oui", MONTANT_PAC_ARRONDI >= 10000)
base_pac_petits <- base_viti |> filter(BENEFICIAIRE_PAC == "Oui", MONTANT_PAC_ARRONDI < 10000)
base_pac_non    <- base_viti |> filter(BENEFICIAIRE_PAC == "Non")

nb_total    <- nrow(base_viti)
nb_pac      <- sum(base_viti$BENEFICIAIRE_PAC == "Oui", na.rm = TRUE)
pct_pac     <- round(nb_pac / nb_total * 100, 1)
total_euros <- sum(base_viti$MONTANT_PAC_ARRONDI, na.rm = TRUE)
```

)

## Row {height=84%}

```{r}
#| title: "Cartographie — Loupe : rechercher une commune (ex. Béziers) | Cible : GPS | Calques : filtres PAC"
leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldGrayCanvas, group = "Plan épuré") |>
  addTiles(group = "Plan détaillé (OSM)") |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") |>
  setView(lng = 3.55, lat = 43.60, zoom = 10) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = base_pac_gros,
    lng = ~LONGITUDE,
    lat = ~LATITUDE,
    radius = 7,
    color = "#1B5E20",
    fillColor = "#2E7D32",
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 1.5,
    popup = ~POPUP_HTML,
    label = ~paste0(NOM_ETABLISSEMENT, " — ", COMMUNE, " (", format(MONTANT_PAC_ARRONDI, big.mark = " "), " €)"),
    group = "PAC ≥ 10 000 €",
    clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions(
      showCoverageOnHover = FALSE,
      spiderfyOnMaxZoom = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = base_pac_petits,
    lng = ~LONGITUDE,
    lat = ~LATITUDE,
    radius = 6,
    color = "#B08938",
    fillColor = "#D4A843",
    fillOpacity = 0.85,
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 1.5,
    popup = ~POPUP_HTML,
    label = ~paste0(NOM_ETABLISSEMENT, " — ", COMMUNE, " (", format(MONTANT_PAC_ARRONDI, big.mark = " "), " €)"),
    group = "PAC < 10 000 €",
    clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions(
      showCoverageOnHover = FALSE,
      spiderfyOnMaxZoom = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = base_pac_non,
    lng = ~LONGITUDE,
    lat = ~LATITUDE,
    radius = 5,
    color = "#5C1A2A",
    fillColor = "#5C1A2A",
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 1,
    popup = ~POPUP_HTML,
    label = ~paste0(NOM_ETABLISSEMENT, " — ", COMMUNE),
    group = "Non-bénéficiaires PAC",
    clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions(
      showCoverageOnHover = FALSE,
      spiderfyOnMaxZoom = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  addSearchOSM(
    options = searchOptions(
      position = "topleft",
      autoCollapse = TRUE,
      minLength = 2,
      zoom = 13,
      textPlaceholder = "Rechercher une commune (ex. Béziers)..."
    )
  ) |>
  addControlGPS(
    options = gpsOptions(
      position = "topleft",
      activate = FALSE,
      autoCenter = TRUE,
      maxZoom = 14,
      setView = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Plan épuré", "Plan détaillé (OSM)", "Satellite"),
    overlayGroups = c("PAC ≥ 10 000 €", "PAC < 10 000 €", "Non-bénéficiaires PAC"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    colors = c("#2E7D32", "#D4A843", "#5C1A2A"),
    labels = c("PAC ≥ 10 000 €", "PAC < 10 000 €", "Non-bénéficiaire PAC"),
    title = "Potentiel PAC",
    opacity = 0.9
  )
```

# Annuaire & Export

```{r}
#| title: "Base prospects filtrable par commune / activité (export CSV / Excel)"
df_tab <- base_viti |>
  transmute(
    Établissement   = NOM_ETABLISSEMENT,
    Commune         = COMMUNE,
    Activité        = ACTIVITE_PRINCIPALE,
    `Bénéf. PAC`    = BENEFICIAIRE_PAC,
    `Aides PAC (€)` = MONTANT_PAC_ARRONDI,
    Adresse         = ADRESSE_COMPLETE,
    Liens = paste0(
      "<a href='", LIEN_GOOGLE_MAPS, "' target='_blank' style='color:#5C1A2A; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none;'>Maps</a> · ",
      "<a href='", LIEN_PAPPERS, "' target='_blank' style='color:#1E293B; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none;'>Pappers</a>"
    )
  )

datatable(
  df_tab,
  escape = FALSE,
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  extensions = "Buttons",
  class = "stripe hover row-border",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 25,
    dom = "Bfrtip",
    buttons = c("csv", "excel"),
    language = list(url = "//cdn.datatables.net/plug-ins/1.13.4/i18n/fr-FR.json")
  )
) |>
  formatCurrency("Aides PAC (€)", currency = " €", before = FALSE, digits = 0, mark = " ")
```
